What are your favorite apps either for motivation or tracking your workouts?

I use a TomTom watch linked to MapMyRun to keep track of my stuff, simple, clean, provides a lot of metrics and it's easy to use.

For motivation I have a lingerie calendar tacked to the wall and I look at the ladies while I pen in my run for the day
I use Jawbone's UP fitness band/software. It's accurate, has modes for tracking workouts and sleep, tracks my macros, and occasionally gives me bits of advice throughout the day. I love it.

Runkeeper for tracking my cardio, thesquatrack.com for lifting. Picked up a Mio Pulse for heart rate training on runs, it integrates okay to runkeeper. Could use the Mio app but don't have much use for it given how much I've got on Runkeeper atm.

Body dysmorphia combined with pictures of beautiful women for motivation. Works okay.

I have Jeffit for tracking my workouts - mostly lifts.

It's OK, but far from ideal. If you are a pro bodybuilder with a routine set in stone, its probably good.

My first big problem is that it has too many workout varieties. That may sound ridiculous, but when you search the term "bench press", it returns something like 30 results. There is no option to limit results to the most common things - the results don't give the standard bench press any more prominence than a Romanian inverted duplex bench reverse press (or whatever crazy things exist). This is very annoying when creating a routine.

Second, the app acts like the routines are set in stone and will never, ever change. If you tell it 5 sets of 8, it will hold you to 5 sets, no matter what you want. You can delete sets off the end without too much difficulty, but adding an extra set (like, to see if you can handle a weight increase, for example) is a total pain. The only options are to either modify the entire routine (thus adding the set to all future workouts), or go through the calendar, select your workout diary for that day, and manually add an extra set to the end of that exercise.

I ended up creating a single exercise routine with all the workouts that I can do, and I selectively pick whichever ones I intend to do on that particular day. I also set it for 5 sets instead of my normal 3, just so I don't need to spend an extra 2 minutes (which is longer than my planned rest time between sets) navigating the calendar and adding the set manually.

One final pet peeve: never, ever workout close to midnight. If you start at 11:30 PM and finish 31 minutes later, it will move the entire exercise to the next day. I have not found any easy way to change the day of a recorded exercise, so on several occasions I've needed to delete an entire record and re-add it manually through the calendar.

It also needs a simple Lock Screen button, so the phone can be placed in the pocket without any buttons being pressed accidentally. I could disable the PIN requirement on my phone, so I could just put the entire phone to sleep, but (from this software developer's point of view) it is absurd to expect a user to disable an overall safety feature just to improve one app.
